title: When HR says 'hostile work environment' 📉
description:
When HR calls you in. Bubbles sits behind an enormous glossy boardroom table on a high chair, tiny laptop open, a row of blank-faced adults in suits staring at him.

"Per my last email: I need a nap." — Bubbles

Bubbles the Baby CEO: A baby. A boardroom. Zero patience for meetings.
Follow for a new episode every day.
